aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Indonesia at 87.27% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 6.09%, followed by Linux at 4.0%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Windows leads at 87.27% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/os-market-share/desktop/indonesia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Windows (87.27%), OS X (6.09%), Linux (4.0%) in October 2026.
